lessons.lesson: Never use 'from tests.test_acceptance import *' in a probe test: pytest collects the imported test_ functions and runs the whole file. Write a standalone probe and delete it with os.remove.
lessons.when: Making a throwaway probe test that needs helpers
lessons.evidence: The probe hit the 120 s timeout and was moved to the background

lessons.lesson: Before asserting a caption such as '1 of 5 rows', probe what the page prints under a filter: the total is the filtered count, so N<M appears only with sampling caps. Also check that the filter column really gets a filter (few distinct values in few rows may not).
lessons.evidence: tests/test_acceptance.py::test_AC_60 and the probe output in this ticket
